molnar_cube_study.name: At each address, a decision - after Molnar
molnar_cube_study.description: Transparent nested cube frames at 4 x 4 x 4 fixed sites. Three reachable sliders independently vary translation, rotation and uniform scale using stable per-site decisions. Depth reveals one to four layers; reset restores the ordered geometry. A spatial interpretation after Vera Molnar’s (Des)Ordres, not a reconstruction of her algorithm.
interactions: Walk around to distinguish the front projection from depth.
Drag TRANSLATE, ROTATE and SCALE, separately or together.
Press DEPTH to reveal one through four indexed layers.
Press RESET to restore all three operation amounts to zero.
molnar_cube_study.qfep_connection: An index retains an identity while visible placement, orientation and size vary. The variation is bounded by authored ranges; local difference need not erase the shared arrangement.
